title: GPT-5 reduces the cost of cell-free protein synthesis
summary: A cycle between GPT-5 and a robotic lab explored over 36,000 compositions and reduced protein-production cost by 40% compared with the previous baseline. This is an experimental result in one CFPS setup; it does not establish the same reduction for other proteins, scales, or facilities.

evidence.tested: Over six rounds in a cloud laboratory, the system tested more than 36,000 reaction compositions on 580 plates and reached a 40% lower protein production cost (57% lower reagent cost).
evidence.unknown: Not stated in the reviewed material
evidence.ai_role: GPT-5 proposed and analyzed experiments in a closed loop with Ginkgo Bioworks automation.
